description:
THE INVISIBLE HAND

"Greed is not a flaw. It is a navigational computer."

— Executive Director’s Internal Memo, Tri-Tachyon Logistics Division (Redacted)

>> OVERVIEW

Are you tired of the mundane? Does the manual transportation of heavy machinery to the outer rim bore you? Do you believe that the intricacies of the commodities market are beneath a captain of your station?

The Invisible Hand is a high-tech fleet command protocol that automates the "boring" parts of sector domination. Recovered from a databank in a defunct Tri-Tachyon black site, this mod allows you to license and commission autonomous Merchant Detachments. These are not simple convoy scripts; they are AI-driven profit engines that buy low, sell high, and manage your logistics network while you focus on what matters: turning your enemies into space dust.

This is the Free Market, Captain. And it is armed.

>> PREVIEW

Spoiler[close]

>> FEATURES

Auto-trade toggle for Nexerelin detachments: Adds Auto-trade / Stop auto-trading options to the Nexerelin Special Task Group command menu.
Profit/day route scoring: Picks routes by adjusted profit per day (travel time + operating cost estimation + economy-aware bonuses + market-impact penalty).
Real market interaction: Buys and sells through normal pricing (Open Market, tariffs included) and applies trade impact modifiers.
Config file: Tune profitability/balance via `data/config/tih_config.json` (see also `data/config/README_CONFIG.txt`). Requires restart to apply.

What it does NOT do (yet):

no fleet commissioning tiers, no AI-core bonuses, no “doctrines”, no smuggling/black market logic,

no LunaLib settings UI

.

Since v1.0.0: support LunaLib setting

>> HOW TO USE

Get a detachment: Create/select a Nexerelin Special Task Group (composition is up to you; more cargo capacity generally means more trade volume).
Enable: Open the detachment command menu and choose Auto-trade.
Disable: Assign other tasks to return the detachment to normal Nexerelin operations.

>> DOWNLOAD & INSTALLATION

>> DOWNLOAD THE INVISIBLE HAND (All versions here) <<

Game version:

Starsector 0.98a-RC8

REQUIRED DEPENDENCIES:

Nexerelin
LazyLib
LunaLib (optional)

"Installation Instructions"

Extract into `Starsector/mods/`.Install the required dependencies and enable them.Enable The Invisible Hand in the launcher.

[close]

>> FAQ & TROUBLESHOOTING

Q: Is this save-compatible?

A: You can add it to an existing save. To remove it safely,

stop auto-trading on all detachments

first, save, then remove the mod.

Q: Where do profits go?

A: Directly into your credits when a sale occurs. Purchases/resupply also spend your credits immediately.

Q: Does it smuggle / use black market?

A: No. Current logic trades via legal markets (Open Market) and pays tariffs.

Q: My detachment stopped trading.

A: If no route meets the minimum profit/day threshold, it will idle and re-evaluate later. You can tune `minProfitPerDay` and other parameters in `data/config/tih_config.json`.

Q: Is this “free money”?

A: It’s an automation tool for mid/late game logistics. You still need a detachment, cargo capacity, and credits to fund purchases and resupply; the algorithm also penalizes over-trading the same markets.

Q: Can I use this to smuggle heavy armaments to the Luddic Path?

A: The "Aggressive" doctrine does not discriminate. If the Path pays well, the Invisible Hand delivers. We are not responsible for any Luddic Church inquisitions you may incur.

CREDITS

Code & design: pe200012Libraries / dependencies: Nexerelin, LazyLibThanks: Fractal Softworks (Alex) and the modding community

"Changelog"

v1.0.2

Fixed crash when stopping auto-trade on saves upgraded to v1.0.1

v1.0.1

Fix multi-fleet coordination queue stale head issue

v1.0.0

Optional LunaLib integration: in-game configuration UI with live updatesVersion Checker metadata for update notificationsCredit usage cap: limit the percent of player credits used for auto-tradingMulti-hop trade planning (beam search lookahead) with uncertainty discount for long travel legsAutomatic adaptation: mid-travel revalidation, replanning, and salvage reroute when a sale would be a large lossMulti-fleet coordination: market-flow reservations, global trading budget cap, fair round-robin budget queue, global planning throttlePlan persistence: saves and restores multi-hop plans after save/loadRoute selection now follows real market flow (excess/deficit) and planning-time reservationsRoute search performance tuned: bounded top-K sources/destinations + cached travel-time/distanceTrade notifications formatting improved for readabilityTrade impact application aligned with vanilla/Nex-style semantics (correct sign + caps by excess/deficit)

v0.1.0

Initial release: Auto-trade task for Nexerelin Special Task GroupsRoute scoring with market-impact penalty + economy-aware bonusesAuto-offload + auto-resupplyIntel UI with trade history + clickable notificationsConfigurable parameters via `data/config/tih_config.json`
